items.title: 52035_Eddie Durham oral history interview
items.q: But if the name's on it with you, it's good and you pay them. But a lot of guys -- because the leader's name has to carry plenty. Just Johnny Hodges it wouldn't go as well as Duke Ellington and Johnny Hodges.
